description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git commit graph behaviors and various Git commands related to commit reachability, merge bases, ancestors, and ref management. It constructs a commit graph, runs various assertions, and verifies behaviors of Git features within a test environment.

methods.name: run_all_modes
methods.description: Runs a specified command in multiple modes, compares output against expected results, and restores the commit graph state after each mode.

methods.name: test_all_modes
methods.description: Runs a specified command in all available modes for testing, using 'run_all_modes' implementation.
